name: Summer Bliss
source:
You're on a trip with your friend and you guys are heading towards the beach!! There you will meet cute guys and hopefully choose the right answers to get you a happily ever after.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231211070749/https://games.renpy.org/game/summerb]Ren'Py Games[/url]]
translation:
你和朋友一起旅行，正朝着海滩前进！！在那里，你会遇见可爱的男孩，希望能选出正确答案，获得幸福结局。

[据[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231211070749/https://games.renpy.org/game/summerb]Ren'Py Games[/url]编辑]
